title: Mobile edge calculation assisted multilayer federal learning method

pse.problem: Limited computing power of car networking devices and long transmission distance between local device and remote data center in smart car networking network, leading to low training accuracy and reduced learning performance under the training time budget.
pse.solution_function: Mobile edge computing-assisted multi-layer federated learning method that offloads latency-sensitive and computationally intensive tasks from distributed mobile devices to nearby edge servers to bring model training closer to connected vehicles, improving training accuracy and learning performance within the given time budget.
pse.solution_structure: Mobile edge servers as nearby computing nodes and multiple user devices with sensing capabilities as clients. The system consists of federated learning layers, each layer responsible for a specific aspect of the learning process.
pse.solution_implementation: Each client performs local data processing and updates its model parameters. Edge servers aggregate model parameters from multiple clients, applying techniques such as client selection to optimize resource allocation. The federated learning process is repeated across multiple layers to achieve high-accuracy training results.
pse.effect: Improved training accuracy and learning performance compared to traditional federated learning methods, while reducing transmission cost and improving latency.
